RVA-F-0398.question: What integer expression does AIUnitChoiceEvaluate use to value rushing a unit, and how does it differ from the human rush cost?

scope.boundary: One local expression and its operands. The result is a candidate difference from the human rush cost, not a confirmed defect and not a claim about what a natural AI turn pays.

dependencies.use: Accepted AIUnitChoiceEvaluate owner 0x82CB44E0, its helper 0x82CF1148 and the signed unit factor at definition +0x44.
Human rush formula, its early division and the command path that this AI block does not submit.

operations.role: unit factor F times effective scalar S
subtract invested production I from F*S
truncating division that forms the Gold rate R, already truncated before use
rate R times the subtracted value
first instruction of the final half
completes the final half with truncation toward zero

arithmetic.domain: Small positive overflow-free operands under stable supplied inputs.
arithmetic.difference: The AI expression subtracts invested production before the final half; the human rush subtracts it after halving the full unit cost.

workedExample.note: Accepted Warrior factor 2. The comparison does not depend on the American half-price bonus.

arithmetic.modelCheck: tools/check-cost-audit.py compares the two expressions over factors 2, 4, 5 and 10, four eras and both bonus alternatives: 1744 supplied cases, 1668 differ. These are cases, not distinct bugs.

currentEvidence.method: Foreground read-only ghidra/DumpMemoryWords.java queries; selected instruction and data words checked against the hash-verified supported flat image; independent opcode, register and shift checks; narrow exact-function generated corroboration.
currentEvidence.qualification: The operations are checked statically. Which item, scalar and rate a natural AI occurrence supplies is not observed.

guards: Do not infer that a natural AI overpays or skips an affordable purchase from the 16 and 18 comparison.
Do not call the difference a defect until live inputs and intended rounding are known.
The 16 and 18 comparison needs matching item, scalar and rate premises; see RVA-F-0401.
RVA-F-0398.conclusion: Under the stated operands, AIUnitChoiceEvaluate computes trunc0(R*(F*S-I)/2), which exceeds the human rush cost R*(trunc0(F*S/2)-I) in the Warrior example (18 against 16). The difference stays a candidate until a live AI occurrence confirms the inputs.

scope.boundary: Two local comparisons. Opaque callee effects and the full set of paths that enter either arm are outside this record.

dependencies.use: The retained amount compared with Gold.

arms.name: policy bit 0x4 arm
arms.entry: An earlier check can enter this arm directly.

arms.name: nonpositive amount
arms.result: A separate item and CityUpdate path without the local debit and production stores.

currentEvidence.method: Foreground read-only ghidra/DumpMemoryWords.java queries; selected instruction and data words checked against the hash-verified supported flat image; independent opcode, register and shift checks; narrow exact-function generated corroboration.
currentEvidence.qualification: Static operand checks only. Equality and signed behavior follow the decoded comparisons; actual Gold reads are not observed.

guards: The amount is an affordability and charge input in this block; that does not show the amount equals what the AI pays in play.

RVA-F-0399.conclusion: Both paid arms compare the retained amount with the owner's Gold: the primary arm needs amount below Gold, and the policy bit 0x4 arm needs amount below half of Gold, truncated toward zero.

RVA-F-0400.question: What do the two paid arms of AIUnitChoiceEvaluate store after the affordability comparison?

scope.boundary: The local stores and the CityUpdate call. The CityUpdate return value and later effects are not described here.

dependencies.use: The two arms that lead to these stores.

effects: Write the selected item to the city.
Debit the amount from the reloaded Gold word.
Increase the 16-bit production by trunc0(amount / recomputedRate).

currentEvidence.method: Foreground read-only ghidra/DumpMemoryWords.java queries; selected instruction and data words checked against the hash-verified supported flat image; independent opcode, register and shift checks; narrow exact-function generated corroboration.
currentEvidence.qualification: Static words checked against the supported image. The first and recomputed rates are equal only when retained era and bonus state match.

guards: No complete CityUpdate contract follows from this record.
Completed production, delivery and the actual Gold change are not observed.
RVA-F-0400.conclusion: Each paid arm writes the item, subtracts the valued amount from Gold, adds production computed from the amount and a recomputed rate, and calls CityUpdate(city, 1).

RVA-F-0401.question: What must a live AI occurrence show before the AI rush valuation difference counts as a gameplay effect?

scope.boundary: The conditions that decide whether the static difference matters. No game observation exists for them.

dependencies.use: The expression whose live inputs are open.
The stores a live occurrence would record.

openConditions: The factor F and scalar S need not describe the same item: the scalar's item-sensitive part uses the old current city item before replacement.
The first rate R and the recomputed rate in the production store are equal only when retained era and bonus state match.
The 16 and 18 comparison needs matching item, scalar and rate premises.
A natural AI occurrence has not been recorded with these identities.
RVA-F-0401.confirmationRequirement: One natural AI occurrence that records both Gold reads, which check or bypass is taken, the stores, the CityUpdate return and the completed outcome.

currentEvidence.method: Static reading of the same words as RVA-F-0398 through RVA-F-0400.

divideMultiplyScreen.qualification: Two bounded runs examined 645 words across these half-open ranges; the source states the counts for the two runs together. The scanner follows only explicit word division results into multiplication within 16 instruction steps. The technology sequence crosses a branch and was assessed from its accepted formula instead. Zero hits on another slice do not establish correctness, and this was not an executable-wide census.

currentEvidence.qualification: This record lists conditions; it adds no observation.

guards: Do not classify the valuation as a defect or an intended policy before confirmation.
RVA-F-0401.conclusion: The valuation difference is a static candidate. Its gameplay effect, if any, needs the live occurrence described above.
